newsitem.title: USA: Sterling Chemicals to purchase SaskChem.
newsitem.headline: Sterling Chemicals to purchase SaskChem.

text.p: Sterling Chemicals Holdings Inc said on Thursday that it expected to close within 60 days an agreement to buy the assets of Saskatoon Chemicals.
Sterling did not disclose a purchase price, but said the acquisition would be financed with a combination of debt and new equity.

SaskChem, located in Saskatchewan, is a subsidiary of Weyerhaeuser Canada, whose parent company is Weyerhaeuser Co. SaskChem employes 165 people and produces five chemical products, including sodium chlorate.
Based in Houston, Texas, Sterling Chemicals is a holding company that manufactures petrochemicals, pulp chemicals and fibers.
